remarks: A charming light-filled 4 bedrooms/ 4baths rental jewel in MINT condition with new baths, gourmet kitchen, freshly painted inside and out, new floors, and beautifully landscaped with pool. Take your pick for your Primary bedroom either on the first floor or upstairs! A relaxing and entertaining retreat with spacious rooms including the first floor family room as well as a great finished Lower Level walk out recreation room with a full kitchen, study, full bath. Could be a separate in-law or out-of-town guest quarters! And enjoy the outdoors in your wonderful screened-in porch overlooking a woodland stream. Convenient to the village, shopping, schools, train and the Merritt.
